Excludes Smart Review and Spaced Review clones from future source pools.

Retained mastery begins explicit decay only after the scheduled review date is missed.
Lower-mastery topics decay faster; decay penalty is capped at 35 points.
Stored answers and accuracy are never rewritten by decay.
Learning Profile now summarizes due, overdue, due-soon, and average retained mastery.
